title: indigo_mount_temma: sync completes through a finalizer instead of the coordinates handler
description: The sync path of MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES finishes in a finalizer rather than in mount_equatorial_coordinates_handler ending with indigo_update_coordinates(), unlike the pattern set in ticket 42b85be0 (BUSY from the change branch, OK/ALERT from the handler). Check that a refused sync keeps its ALERT and that the OK publication carries the mount-reported position. Found while working on ticket 42b85be0-1f19-4607-b3c3-746e60317d17 (closed, commit a09e0f878), which introduced the kept coordinates ALERT in indigo_update_coordinates(): an ALERT published after a BUSY stays until the next BUSY. Reproduce in the driver's simulator suite before changing code.

outcome.summary: Pass. Conclusion 'no driver defect' is sound. Sync path in indigo_mount_temma.driver: change_property publishes BUSY through INDIGO_COPY_TARGETS_PROCESS_COORDINATES_CHANGE/indigo_update_coordinates; on_change (driver:550-567) publishes BUSY or, on STN-OFF/T/D failure or R1-R3, ALERT through indigo_update_coordinates; mount_goto_finalizer (driver:289-319) reads E before s and publishes OK/ALERT with the reported position through indigo_update_coordinates; on_timer (driver:383-393) rewrites non-BUSY to OK but through indigo_update_coordinates, so the keep-ALERT flag (indigo_libs/indigo_mount_driver.c:1386-1398) turns it back to ALERT. No sync path ends OK after a refusal or publishes the request as values. Test temma_sync_result_and_refusals (test_mount_temma_simulator.c:1901-1997) is not vacuous: epoch 2000 is default and the trace check D201201+61000 pins the rounding (RA diff 3.7e-5 h > 1e-5, Dec 4.2e-4 deg > 1e-4), so the request-vs-reported check is deterministic. I reproduced both mutations independently on scratch copies: values=targets in the finalizer OK fails at :1956; indigo_update_property+return in the refusal branch fails check_alert_kept at :1978. Formatting follows the rules. Records: README line replaces the same-configuration line (indigo_test/AGENTS.md:637), agrees with TEST_SUMMARY.md and version 28 (0x0300001C); MIGRATION_STATUS 32/0 = 30 simulator cases on macOS + 2 deadline cases. I reran locally: simulator 30/30 and deadline 2/2 pass. Nothing else touched. Out-of-scope observations for the owner, not blocking: (1) the generated mount_equatorial_coordinates_handler (indigo_mount_temma.c:649) appends indigo_update_coordinates after an on_change that names a _finalizer, so every request publishes BUSY or ALERT twice; this is harmless for keep-ALERT. (2) The generator's in-handler parked guard (indigo_mount_temma.c:626-630) publishes ALERT with INDIGO_UPDATE_PROPERTY_STATE after the macro's BUSY, which bypasses indigo_update_coordinates. Only a rac

history.text: Characterizing sync result and refused-sync ALERT with a new simulator case
No driver defect: new case passes on unchanged driver; 2 mutations detected. Running full temma suites

Reproduction attempt: new simulator case temma_sync_result_and_refusals (indigo_test/integration/test_mount_temma_simulator.c) run against the UNCHANGED driver 3.0.0.28 passed. (1) Accepted sync with a request finer than the mount units (20.20013 h, 61.00042 deg -> D201201+61000): BUSY with old position, OK publication carries the position read by E in mount_goto_finalizer (equal within 1e-6 to the later polls, not the request), targets = request; nothing between BUSY and OK other than BUSY. (2) Sync refused with R1 and (3) unanswered D: one D, ALERT with the previous position, and every later poll publication stays ALERT (>=2 polls) via indigo_update_coordinates() keep-ALERT; next sync goes BUSY -> OK. Mutation check: publishing the request as values in the sync OK fails the case (SYNC check at line ~1956); publishing the refusal ALERT with indigo_update_property() and returning (bypassing indigo_update_coordinates) fails check_alert_kept. Conclusion: the deviation is structural only (sync completes in mount_goto_finalizer 0.1 s later instead of in the handler); no observable defect, so no driver change and no version bump. Generated .c/.h/_main.c verified identical to unchanged build/bin/indigo_generator output. Recorded run: 2026-11-20 18:50 3.0.0.28 mac arm64 simulator 32/32 OK; MIGRATION_STATUS automated tests 31/0 -> 32/0. Not verified: Linux/Windows, hardware, MountSim.

This is generator-owned, common to generated mounts and not specific to sync. Not verified: Linux/Windows, hardware, MountSim.
